text:
lina: Working doc posted — draft playbook for on‑prem + VPC upgrades and customer‑managed networking. Need product + eng to agree scope before Q2 planning. https://rdw.in/notes/onprem-upgrade-playbook :spiral_notepad:
ajay: skimmed. big questions: zero-downtime requirement from sales — do we commit to live kv-cache migrations or soft-fallback? :thinking_face:
marta: sales asked for explicit upgrade SLAs (max 15m per node) and an escape hatch for air-gapped installs. we should list must-have vs nice-to-have.
sam: proposal: default path = rolling upgrade with schema-compatible checkpoints + automatic failover to standby cluster. optional path = offline bundle for air-gapped. both in playbook.
lina: agree. need clear diagnostics and rollback steps in operator. also call out networking: customer-managed NAT or transit gateway options.
ajay: for customer-managed networking we need 2 modes in config: "ingress-proxy" and "direct-peer". direct-peer requires BGP/route-exports from customer's edge. we should include config snippet.

```yaml
networking:
  mode: direct-peer # ingress-proxy | direct-peer
  allowed_cidrs:
    - 10.0.0.0/8
  control_plane_port: 8443
```

sam: +1. Also add a cert rotation path for control-plane certs when customer rotates KMS/HSM keys.
marta: Launch criteria suggestion (must): 1) rolling upgrade validated on k8s + bare-metal lab, 2) documented air-gapped bundle and checksum verification, 3) runbook with SLA rollback & post-upgrade smoke tests, 4) customer-networking playbook with diagram and config examples.
ajay: prioritization: Q2 MVP should include rolling upgrade + ingress-proxy network mode + air-gapped bundle. direct-peer + BGP support in Q3 unless we have a strong customer commit.

lina: can we attach an owner for validation tests? @ajay for rolling upgrade, @sam for networking validations, @marta for docs and customer comms.
ajay: I can own rolling upgrade tests. I'll build an e2e that simulates KV warm-cold transitions + 0% request loss target.
sam: I'll run networking interop with a partner lab. need two weeks of lab time in May.
marta: I'll draft the customer comms and escalation flow. will also prepare the checklist for sales to set expectations.

deploy-bot: deploy-note: test-runner/upgrade-e2e started by ajay at 2026-05-08T09:12:03Z (run id: e2e-1767895321)
ajay: started a PR with the test harness and playbook changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onprem-playbook/pull/98
lina: thanks. let's sync on Monday 10am to finalize which features are gated vs post-launch. agenda: scope, owners, and acceptance tests. :calendar:
sam: noted. one more item — upgrade telemetry: we need to capture per-node CPU spike windows and a token-cost delta report to give customers visibility into performance during upgrade.
marta: great callout. add to post-upgrade checklist.
lina: perfect. if there are no objections I'll lock Q2 scope tomorrow and open the rollout schedule. please flag any blockers today. :thumbsup:
